title: The Customers table lists, sorts and pages as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • The organization has more customers than the Customers table first loads (this site does: the table loads about 30 rows and more as you scroll).
  • Needs no test data of its own.

Setup

  1. Check the setup worked: Customers (top menu) shows the table with the Customer Name, Telephone, Address 1, Address 2, City, State/Province and Assets columns.
custom_steps:
1. Click Customers in the top menu.
  2. Read the first page of rows.
  3. Click the Customer Name column header.
  4. Read the order of the rows in the Customer Name column.
  5. Go to the next page: scroll to the bottom of the table so the next rows load.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the table shows rows with no error message.
  • Step 4: rows are in name order.
  • Step 5: the next page shows different customers, still in name order, with no repeats.
